name: @stageflow/contracts-scanner-manifest
description: Scanner manifest schema and types for StageFlow

scripts.generate: bun run generate:ts && bun run generate:go
scripts.generate:go: go run github.com/atombender/go-jsonschema@v0.20.0 --package scannermanifest --tags json --struct-name-from-title schema/scanner-manifest.schema.json > scanner_manifest.go
scripts.validate:fixtures: node schema/validate.js fixtures/scanner-manifest.min.json && node schema/validate.js fixtures/scanner-manifest.full.json
scripts.build: bun run generate && bun run validate:fixtures && tsc
